meta.source: Original fictional microdrama written for the public demo - not a real show

1.logline: Maya Reyes, a night-shift film archivist at Hale Pictures, finds an unlabelled reel carrying her missing father's name; studio head Victor Hale walks in and demands it.
1.continuity_notes: Original demo show for AI Promo Intelligence Studio.

2.logline: Thrown out of the studio, Maya is stopped in the rain by Daniel Hale, Victor's son, who has taken the reel from his father's office and wants to know what it hides.
2.continuity_notes: Original demo show for AI Promo Intelligence Studio.

3.logline: Ruth Okafor, an old projectionist and Maya's mentor, screens the reel: it shows the studio fire twenty years ago and a man locking a door from outside.
3.continuity_notes: Original demo show for AI Promo Intelligence Studio.

4.logline: At the Hale Pictures anniversary gala, Maya confronts Victor in public; Lena Hale humiliates her, Daniel defends her, and Victor accuses Maya of theft in front of the press.
4.continuity_notes: Original demo show for AI Promo Intelligence Studio.

5.logline: Arrested after the gala, Maya meets Inspector Kwame Osei, who reveals that her father's case was closed on orders from above - and that Thomas Reyes was seen alive three years ago.
5.continuity_notes: Original demo show for AI Promo Intelligence Studio.

6.logline: Daniel discovers forty frames are missing from the reel and finds them in Victor's private safe; Victor catches him and disowns him.
6.continuity_notes: Original demo show for AI Promo Intelligence Studio.

7.logline: Victor orders the old archive emptied by fire; Maya and Ruth are trapped inside, Daniel breaks them out, and the security footage shows a living man in the archive.
7.continuity_notes: Original demo show for AI Promo Intelligence Studio.

8.logline: At the Hale Pictures premiere, Maya screens the restored reel to the press; Victor's crime plays on the big screen, Thomas Reyes appears, and Victor makes one last move.
8.continuity_notes: Original demo show for AI Promo Intelligence Studio.

lines.text: SCENE 01 - INT. HALE PICTURES ARCHIVE VAULT - NIGHT
Slow push through rows of steel film cans glowing under a single work lamp.
Maya threads an old reel onto the restoration bench, gloves on, breath fogging in the cold vault.
The projector motor coughs, then hums.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Can 4417. No title, no date. Who hides a film down here?
She turns the can over. A strip of masking tape reads: PROPERTY OF THOMAS REYES.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Dad?
Close on Maya's trembling hand over the faded handwriting.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Twenty years. They told us there was nothing left of him. Not one frame.
The vault door slams. Footsteps on concrete.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: That can is not on your restoration list, Miss Reyes.
Victor Hale steps into the lamp light, silver hair, black overcoat, two security guards behind him.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: It was misfiled. I was logging it.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: Give it to me.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: It has my father's name on it.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: Your father stole from this studio. Everything he touched belongs to me.
Victor nods. A guard grabs Maya's wrist and twists the reel out of her hands.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Let go of me!

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: She's finished here. Escort her out. And take her keycard.
SCENE 02 - INT. ARCHIVE CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS
The guards march Maya down the corridor. She glances back.
Through the vault window: Victor alone, holding the reel up to the light.
Victor's face drains of colour as he reads the frames.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: He filmed it. That fool actually filmed it.
He lowers the reel. In the frame, frozen: a younger Victor standing beside a burning door.
SCENE 01 - EXT. HALE PICTURES GATE - NIGHT - RAIN
Rain hammers the studio gate. A guard shoves Maya onto the wet pavement and tosses her bag after her.

lines.speaker: GUARD
lines.text: Mr Hale says you're lucky he isn't calling the police.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Tell Mr Hale I know what's on that reel.
A car engine. Headlights sweep across Maya's face.
A black sedan stops. The window lowers: Daniel Hale, Victor's son.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Get in. You'll catch pneumonia arguing with a gate.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: You're his son. Why would I trust you?
Daniel lifts a film can from the passenger seat. Can 4417.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Because I took this from his desk ten minutes ago.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: You stole from your own father?
SCENE 02 - INT. DANIEL'S CAR - MOVING - NIGHT
Wipers beat. Streetlights slide across their faces.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: I've never seen him afraid. Tonight he locked himself in his office and burned papers.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Then you know he's hiding something.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: I know he called someone and said one sentence. The Reyes girl has seen it.
Maya's phone lights up. Unknown number. A text: GIVE BACK THE REEL OR YOUR MOTHER'S HOUSE BURNS TOO.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Too? What does he mean, too?
Daniel swerves to the kerb and stares at the message.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: The old studio fire. The one where your father disappeared.
SCENE 01 - INT. RIALTO CINEMA - PROJECTION BOOTH - NIGHT
Dust floats in the beam of a vintage projector.
Ruth Okafor, seventy, threads Can 4417 with practised hands while Maya and Daniel watch.

lines.speaker: RUTH
lines.text: Nitrate stock. If this catches, the whole booth goes up in seconds. Nobody breathes on it.
The projector clatters to life.
On the small screen: grainy footage of the old Hale studio lot at night.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: That's the old sound stage. The one that burned.
On screen, flames climb the stage wall. A man in a long coat chains the fire door shut.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Someone locked them in.
Ruth stops the projector on a single frame. The man's hand: a heavy signet ring.

lines.speaker: RUTH
lines.text: I know that ring. I've seen it on one man for forty years.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Say it.
SCENE 02 - INT. RIALTO CINEMA - PROJECTION BOOTH - CONTINUOUS

lines.speaker: RUTH
lines.text: Victor Hale.
Daniel steps back from the screen as if struck.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: No. My father was a producer, not a murderer.
Downstairs, the cinema's front door bangs open.

lines.speaker: RUTH
lines.text: Were you followed?
Footsteps race up the stairs. The booth door handle begins to turn.
SCENE 01 - INT. HALE PICTURES GALA - BALLROOM - NIGHT
Crystal chandeliers, cameras flashing, a giant banner: HALE PICTURES, FIFTY YEARS OF STORIES.
Maya, in a borrowed black dress, walks straight through the crowd toward the stage.

lines.speaker: LENA
lines.text: Look who crawled in. The archive girl my father fired for stealing.
Lena Hale, Victor's daughter, tips a glass of champagne down the front of Maya's dress.
Laughter ripples through the guests.

lines.speaker: LENA
lines.text: Oops. Now you look like what you are.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Enough, Lena.
Daniel steps between them and offers Maya his jacket. The room goes quiet.

lines.speaker: LENA
lines.text: You're taking her side? Over family?

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: I'm taking the side of the truth.
On stage, Victor taps the microphone. Every camera turns to him.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: Friends. Tonight we celebrate fifty years. And tonight, sadly, a thief is in this room.
A spotlight swings onto Maya.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: That woman stole a priceless reel from my archive. Officers, please.
Two police officers push through the crowd toward Maya. Cameras flash in her face.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Ask him what's on the reel! Ask him who chained the fire door!
Victor's smile does not move. But his hand closes into a fist around the microphone.
SCENE 01 - INT. CENTRAL POLICE STATION - INTERVIEW ROOM - NIGHT
A bare table, a buzzing light, Maya alone with champagne still drying on her dress.
Inspector Kwame Osei enters with a thick, dusty case file and drops it on the table.

lines.speaker: OSEI
lines.text: Thomas Reyes. Missing, presumed dead in the Hale studio fire. Case closed in nine days.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Nine days. For seven people.

lines.speaker: OSEI
lines.text: Closed on orders from the deputy commissioner. Who played golf every Sunday with Victor Hale.
Maya looks up sharply.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Why are you telling me this?

lines.speaker: OSEI
lines.text: Because tonight Hale asked me to lose you in the system. And I don't like being told what to lose.
Osei slides a grainy photograph across the table: a grey-bearded man at a ferry terminal.

lines.speaker: OSEI
lines.text: Border camera. Three years ago.
Close on the photograph. The man's face. Maya's face, thirty years older.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: That's impossible.

lines.speaker: OSEI
lines.text: Your father isn't dead, Miss Reyes. He walked out of that fire.
The door bursts open.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: Inspector. My lawyer would like a word with you. Outside.
SCENE 01 - INT. VICTOR'S STUDY - HALE MANSION - NIGHT
Daniel kneels at a wall safe behind a framed film poster, a stethoscope pressed to the dial.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Forty frames cut out of the reel. If he kept anything, he kept it here.
Click. The safe swings open.
Inside: a small film tin labelled 4417-B. Beside it, a passport with a stranger's name and Thomas Reyes's face.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: He knew. He's known where Reyes was all along.
Daniel opens the tin. He holds a strip of frames to the desk lamp.
In the frames: Victor at the fire door, turning to look straight at the camera.
A lamp switches on behind him.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: You always were the curious one.
Victor stands in the doorway in a dressing gown, a glass of whisky in his hand.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Seven people died in that fire. You chained the door.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: I built this family on that fire. Your school, your car, your name.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Then I don't want any of it.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: Put the frames down, Daniel. Choose carefully.
Daniel pockets the film strip.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: Then from tonight, you are not my son.
SCENE 01 - INT. HALE PICTURES OLD ARCHIVE - NIGHT
Maya and Ruth search the shelves of the abandoned archive by torchlight.

lines.speaker: RUTH
lines.text: If your father hid a second reel, it's in the nitrate room. He never trusted anyone else's shelves.
Behind them, a heavy door slams. A chain rattles through the handles.
Maya runs back and pulls the door. It won't move.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Someone chained it. From outside.
A crackle. The smell of smoke rolls under the door.

lines.speaker: RUTH
lines.text: Same door. Same trick. He's doing it again.
Smoke pours through the vents. Ruth coughs and sinks to her knees.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Ruth, stay with me. Stay low!
Metal shrieks. Bolt cutters bite through the chain.
The door crashes open. Daniel, soot on his face, hauls Ruth over his shoulder.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Go! The roof's coming down!
SCENE 02 - EXT. OLD ARCHIVE - NIGHT
They stumble into the night as the archive roof collapses behind them.
Daniel hands Maya a security tablet he grabbed from the guard booth.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: The cameras were still recording. Look at the nitrate room.
On the tablet: a grey-bearded man in the smoke, clutching a film can, slipping out a side door.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: He was in there. My father was in there tonight.
SCENE 01 - INT. HALE PICTURES PREMIERE THEATRE - NIGHT
A packed premiere. Press in every row. Victor in the front seat, smiling for the cameras.
The lights dim. Instead of the trailer, grainy footage fills the giant screen: the burning sound stage.
A gasp runs through the audience.
On screen, the man in the long coat chains the fire door, then turns. Victor's younger face, enormous.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: Stop this! Turn it off!
In the projection booth window above, Maya and Ruth keep the reel running.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Seven people. Twenty years. Everyone in this room should see it.
Inspector Osei walks down the aisle toward Victor with two officers.

lines.speaker: OSEI
lines.text: Victor Hale, you're under arrest for the murders at Stage Nine.
Victor backs away. A side door opens. A grey-bearded man steps into the projector beam.

lines.speaker: THOMAS
lines.text: Hello, Victor. You missed me.
Maya freezes in the booth window.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Dad?
Victor grabs a gun from an officer's holster and turns it on the projection booth.

lines.speaker: VICTOR
lines.text: Stop the reel, Maya. Or this is the last thing your father ever watches.
